items.q: How can one n8n agent act like a full marketing team?
items.a: A thin **orchestrator agent** exposes **six tools**, each a separate n8n sub-workflow: create image, edit image, search image database, blog post, LinkedIn post, and faceless video — controlled via **Telegram** (voice or text).

items.q: What pattern links the main agent to those sub-workflows?
items.a: The **workflow-as-tool** pattern: sub-workflows start with "When executed by another workflow" and defined inputs; the main agent uses **Call n8n workflow** so the model fills parameters like image title, prompt, and chat ID.

items.q: How do voice and text reach the agent the same way?
items.a: Voice is transcribed to text; both paths normalize to **`JSON.text`** so the agent sees one input shape. Results return to Telegram and log to **Google Sheets** + **Google Drive**.

items.q: What belongs in the system prompt?
items.a: Keep it simple: list each tool and when to use it; handle synonyms (**"make" = edit**); avoid duplicate delivery for blog/LinkedIn because the sub-workflow already sends content.

items.q: How do create vs edit image flows stay consistent?
items.a: Sheets act as an **image database** (title, type, request, Drive ID, link, post). Edit needs the prior image binary — search returns the Drive ID, then edit downloads it. Image gen uses OpenAI GPT image (~**$0.19**/image).

items.q: What stack builds the ~20-second faceless video?
items.a: **Flux** (PI API) → **Runway** image-to-video → **ElevenLabs** SFX → **Creatomate** render. Prefer **polling** over fixed 90s waits; ballpark ~**$1**/video (Runway ~$0.25 per 5-sec clip).

items.q: What breaks when video generation runs too long?
items.a: The **main agent times out** waiting on the subflow. Workaround: **subflow-timeout-callback** — the video sub-workflow sends the final clip to Telegram directly (agent errors, but you still get the video).

items.q: What's the rough monthly cost stack?
items.a: n8n cloud ~**$27**/mo; OpenAI images ~**$0.19** each; Flux ~**$0.015**/image; ElevenLabs starter **$5**/mo; GPT-4.1 mini via Open Router for reasoning. Free **7 JSON workflows** + Sheet log + Creatomate script via AI Automation Society Skool.
